name: Aoife Josie Clements
bio: Aoife Josie Clements, known professionally as Ravine Angel, is a Canadian musician and actress based in Vancouver.

credits.title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
credits.overview: Michaela tries her best to be a good person.

credits.title: Platypus
credits.overview: Kimberly, a young schoolgirl in a small town, secretly dreams of the masked killer Platypus terrorizing the area. But nobody believes her, and the dreams are becoming more vivid, more violent, and ever closer to home.

credits.title: rip :'(
credits.overview: This monochromatic 3D-animated fantasia, created entirely in the Unity game engine, begins with a dead girl in a shower and ends with a full-scale battle for the streets of Vancouver. The progression from A to B is a Rube Goldbergian machine of horrors and kinetic delights. Taken from the album "Object of Affection"

credits.overview: Over the course of nearly two years, Louise Weard and her loved ones test the limits of filmmaking, friendship and sanity as they try to finish shooting her seven-hour epic: The Untitled Louise Weard Castration Movie.

credits.title: Castration Movie Anthology ii. The Best of Both Worlds

credits.title: Castration Movie Anthology I. Traps
credits.overview: Michaela 'Traps' Sinclair is a trans sex worker trying to get by in Vancouver while also mentoring her recently-out friend Adeline and making an attempt at pursuing actual motherhood. Meanwhile, lowly production assistant Turner finds himself dangerously spiraling into inceldom as his current relationship implodes.
